title: 导航控制台导致电力完全关闭，且无法重新启动引擎
description: 导航控制台导致电力完全关闭，且无法重新启动引擎
evidence: FInd a nav console, sit at it, do nothing and power goes out. Back to the engine, cant turn it back on, no idea why even though there was over 20kg of fuel.

evidence_items.quote: FInd a nav console, sit at it, do nothing and power goes out. Back to the engine, cant turn it back on, no idea why even though there was over 20kg of fuel.
evidence_items.description: 导航控制台导致电力完全关闭，且无法重新启动引擎
evidence_items.quote_zh: 找到一个导航控制台，坐在它前面，什么都不做，然后电力就断了。回到引擎那里，无法重新打开它，不知道为什么，尽管有超过20公斤的燃料。
